"""design_EC59 모델링 준비: 코호트·결과·특성·분할 테이블 생성 (학습/성능 계산 없음)."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

WS = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
D = WS / "data"
OUT = WS / "prep"
design = json.loads((WS / "design_EC59.json").read_text())

p = pd.read_csv(D / "patients.csv.gz")
a = pd.read_csv(D / "admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time", "discharge_time"])
dx = pd.read_csv(D / "diagnoses.csv.gz")
o = pd.read_csv(D / "orders.csv.gz", parse_dates=["order_time"])
lab = pd.read_csv(D / "labs.csv.gz", parse_dates=["collect_time", "report_time"])

a = a.sort_values(["patient_id", "admit_time"]).reset_index(drop=True)
a["tp"] = a["discharge_time"]  # tp.anchor=discharge, offset 0h
data_end = a["discharge_time"].max()

# ---- outcome: 같은 환자의 다음 입원 시작이 (tp, tp+30d] 안에 있는가
a["next_admit"] = a.groupby("patient_id")["admit_time"].shift(-1)
a["readmit_30d"] = ((a["next_admit"] > a["tp"]) &
                    (a["next_admit"] <= a["tp"] + pd.Timedelta(days=30))).astype(int)
a["followup_complete"] = (a["tp"] + pd.Timedelta(days=30)) <= data_end

# ---- cohort
c = a.merge(p, on="patient_id", how="left")
c = c[c["age"] >= 18]
c = c[c["discharge_status"] != "died"].copy()

# ---- features
c["n_prior_adm"] = c.groupby("patient_id").cumcount()  # 같은 환자의 이전 입원 수
c["los_h"] = (c["discharge_time"] - c["admit_time"]).dt.total_seconds() / 3600  # length_of_stay_h 컬럼 부재 → 계산

# 진단: 시각 정보 없음 → 해당(지표) 입원에 연결된 코드만 사용 (설계서에 scope 미지정; 보고서 참조)
dx["c3"] = dx["icd_code"].str[:3]
g = dx.groupby("admission_id")
dxf = pd.DataFrame({
    "n_dx": g.size(),
    "dx_chf": g["c3"].apply(lambda s: int((s == "I50").any())),
    "dx_ckd": g["c3"].apply(lambda s: int((s == "N18").any())),
})
c = c.merge(dxf, left_on="admission_id", right_index=True, how="left")
c[["n_dx", "dx_chf", "dx_ckd"]] = c[["n_dx", "dx_chf", "dx_ckd"]].fillna(0).astype(int)

# 오더: [admit, tp]
oo = o[o["order_type"] == "dialysis_order"].merge(c[["admission_id", "admit_time", "tp"]], on="admission_id")
oo = oo[(oo["order_time"] >= oo["admit_time"]) & (oo["order_time"] <= oo["tp"])]
c["dialysis_ordered"] = c["admission_id"].isin(oo["admission_id"]).astype(int)

# 검사: report_time 기준 [admit, tp]
L = lab.merge(c[["admission_id", "admit_time", "tp"]], on="admission_id")
L = L[(L["report_time"] >= L["admit_time"]) & (L["report_time"] <= L["tp"])]
cr = L[L["test"] == "creatinine"].sort_values("report_time").groupby("admission_id")["value"].last()
hg = L[L["test"] == "hemoglobin"].groupby("admission_id")["value"].min()
c["cr_last"] = c["admission_id"].map(cr)
c["hgb_min"] = c["admission_id"].map(hg)

# prior_cr_last: 같은 환자의 이전 입원들 검사 중 report_time <= tp 인 마지막 크레아티닌
pl = lab[lab["test"] == "creatinine"].merge(a[["admission_id", "patient_id", "admit_time"]], on="admission_id")
pl = pl.rename(columns={"admit_time": "lab_adm_time"})
x = c[["admission_id", "patient_id", "admit_time", "tp"]].merge(pl[["patient_id", "lab_adm_time", "report_time", "value"]], on="patient_id")
x = x[(x["lab_adm_time"] < x["admit_time"]) & (x["report_time"] <= x["tp"])]
c["prior_cr_last"] = c["admission_id"].map(x.sort_values("report_time").groupby("admission_id")["value"].last())

# ---- split: family_id 그룹 홀드아웃 (family_id 결측 환자는 patient_id 를 그룹키로 대체 — 확인 필요)
c["split_group"] = c["family_id"].fillna("PAT_" + c["patient_id"])
groups = np.array(sorted(c["split_group"].unique()))
rng = np.random.default_rng(design["split"]["seed"])
test_groups = set(rng.choice(groups, size=int(round(len(groups) * design["split"]["test_fraction"])), replace=False))
c["split"] = np.where(c["split_group"].isin(test_groups), "test", "train")

feats = [f["name"] for f in design["features"]]
cols = ["admission_id", "patient_id", "family_id", "split_group", "split", "tp",
        "followup_complete", "readmit_30d"] + feats
c[cols].to_csv(OUT / "analysis_table.csv", index=False)

summary = {
    "n_admissions_total": int(len(a)),
    "n_cohort": int(len(c)), "n_patients": int(c["patient_id"].nunique()),
    "outcome_rate": round(float(c["readmit_30d"].mean()), 4),
    "outcome_by_discharge_status": c.groupby("discharge_status")["readmit_30d"].agg(["mean", "size"]).round(4).to_dict("index"),
    "outcome_by_unit": c.groupby("unit")["readmit_30d"].agg(["mean", "size"]).round(4).to_dict("index"),
    "followup_incomplete": int((~c["followup_complete"]).sum()),
    "family_id_missing_frac_cohort": round(float(c["family_id"].isna().mean()), 4),
    "split_counts": c["split"].value_counts().to_dict(),
    "split_outcome_rate": c.groupby("split")["readmit_30d"].mean().round(4).to_dict(),
    "missing_frac": c[feats].isna().mean().round(4).to_dict(),
    "group_overlap_train_test": int(len(set(c.loc[c.split == "train", "split_group"]) & set(c.loc[c.split == "test", "split_group"]))),
    "patient_overlap_train_test": int(len(set(c.loc[c.split == "train", "patient_id"]) & set(c.loc[c.split == "test", "patient_id"]))),
}
(OUT / "prep_summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
EOF
